Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to take the place of a Weber Silver gas grill. My former Weber was always bigger than I needed, and I find that the Q1200 is more than adequate for all my grilling needs. Easy to clean and maintain, too. I hooked it up to the same big propane tank my former grill used. Bought small propane bottles so I could take it along on picnics. It cooks really well, too.
Results.Title: Compact yet ample grill space

Results.ReviewText: I went all out and bought a few accessories as it is a permanent fixture on our patio, thus I have it on the Weber stand, a hose connected to a large propane bottle, and a cover to protect it from the weather and environment.   It is a quality grill that heats accurately and evenly, is easy to clean and takes up little space.  A few days ago I grilled a rib eye that turned out perfectly, and I have to say, I have never had one better!  It was delicious!!
Results.Title: Great Grilling

Results.ReviewText: I bought this one for my camper about 5 months ago to replace using charcoal grill and happy I did.
Results.Title: Great design and features

Results.ReviewText: I bought it last year, works good, but burner holes are too small. Hard to keep from stopping up. Need wheels on front and back!
Results.Title: Burner

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill last summer and can't wait for BBQ season 2018. This little grill is dynamite for grilling steaks, burgers, fish, veggies, pizza...whatever...for up to 4 people. As a single woman, I love how easily it can be stored away in my garage during winter months. I also bought the optional stand which wheels out from under the eaves where I keep the BBQ when not in use on my deck during the summer months. The stand collapses and the grill is simple to lift off the stand for over-winter storage. The heavy grills are in two pieces making for super-simple cleaning in the kitchen sink. The heating unit cooks evenly and heats up quickly. The color choices are an added fun plus! (I bought orange to go with my outdoor furniture/patio umbrella.) This would be an ideal unit for RVers, too. For singles or couples, this is 
a super, SUPER grill!
Results.Title: Love This Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I moved into a condo and didn't need my big fans grill anymore, so got this little grill.  It works great for me. I can store it in my garage in the winter. The only thing I'm not crazier about is the little canisters of gas because I don't know how to dispose of them.

Results.ReviewText: The size and convenience of the grill is excellent.  It is perfect for a two-person family.  It's greatest drawback is it doesn't get hot enough.  We cannot sear the meat to seal in the juices.  It cooks more like a smoker (but no smoke) than a grill.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill with travel in mind. We take long weekends at VRBO/Home Away vacation homes, and if the grill provided does not fit the bill, this works out perfect. I also take this grill on Kayak trips, and ice fishing. A small propane tank lasts a good amount of time, and the heat from the grill is awesome.

Had to use ours at home when I ran out of propane in our 20 pound tank on the home grill. Worked flawlessly. Its a bit heavy but its worth it. Very sturdy and I expect many years of use. Awesome grill.

Cons: heavy, no carry handle - kinda hard to carry, especially since it is really heavy, also uncomfortable to clean since the walls are not straight, but curved.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this size grill for our second home in Florida as we don't have a lot of storage space. Having it on the portable stand with an adapter hose for a 20lb tank gives it even more versatility. However, even more than that, this little Weber grills perfectly. In the past, I have bought the $99 specials from the outdoor displays at the big box stores and they have lasted, at the most, 2 years. And, they cooked very unevenly and almost always flamed up and burned whatever I was cooking. I grilled a 1" thick ribeye last night, 4 minutes on each side......perfection! I will (and have) recommended buying a Weber because as the saying goes, "you get what you pay for"!

I only regret not buying this grill sooner!

Results.ReviewText: I've previously only owned charcoal Weber kettle grills and loved them.  I didn't think I'd ever buy a gas grill (I'm 70 so that's saying something) but we bought a condo in Florida that doesn't have much space to store a grill let alone the supplies you need for a charcoal grill.  I think this little propane grill is great!  I doesn't take up much space in the garage, it's easy to use and the foods taste great when cooked on it.  The propane tanks last a lot longer than I expected, too.  So far I've only been cooking for the two of us.  Time will tell how it works for larger groups.

Results.ReviewText: I got this as a gift last summer.  It is very easy to set up and it lights instantly.  The flame is easy to control, it heats evenly and flare ups are minimal.  I've done steaks, chicken, pork chops, hamburgers and hot dogs.  It does a good job, no matter what I am grilling.  It is also easy to clean and the grease catcher on the bottom works very well.  I've had a couple other portable gas grills.  I used them for picnics when I needed them to be ready quickly and cool down fast was I was done, but they didn't do a good job.  I just used them for hot dogs and I used charcoal for real meat.  Now I'll never use charcoal again.  This is just as good.

Results.ReviewText:
I was searching for a small gas grill that was easy to use and had upgraded features like an electric start, thermostat, and heavy iron grates.  The Weber Q1200 fits all of these requirements, and more.  Because it uses a gas canister, I don't have to lug around a huge gas tank to get refilled.  It heats up fast and cooks everything evenly.  It's perfect in every way.  The Weber design team did an outstanding job.  The choice of colors is awesome.  Mine is purple.

I, also, purchased the 6557 Portable Cart.  I just wish it was sturdier, but it does the job.
